description.en: The nature spirits ripen the fields at once: minutes of rice come in now.
description.fil: Pinahihinog agad ng mga espiritu ng kalikasan ang bukid: ilang minutong ani ang dumarating ngayon.

sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
F. Landa Jocano, Philippine Mythology (Community Publishers, 1969)
